inclusion_rule: step-table rows naming a known agent (deduplicated by phase step agent attempt); agent-report files where a phase has no step table
done executions with no repair file and no critical or major finding for the same agent in the same phase
finding rows of review reports; first mention of an ID per phase
one repair-*.md file = one repair invocation
repair files over phases in the population
final STATUS line of an agent report is BLOCKED-ON

BLOCKED-ON rows of summaries and logs deduplicated by phase step and agent (empty step matches any): rows matching a terminal report or an earlier row (summaries then runbook logs) are duplicate_of and not counted; rows naming no agent counted
terminal reports plus unmatched rows; only phases with a summary step table or a runbook log

gate or summary list rows naming a manual intervention; list items and table body rows only (prose not counted); a row matching an unmatched row of the same phase type and agent in a higher-precedence file (gate then summaries) is duplicate_of and not counted

gate or summary list rows saying a guard or hook blocked something; list items and table body rows only (prose not counted); a row matching an unmatched row of the same phase type and agent in a higher-precedence file (gate then summaries) is duplicate_of and not counted

gate or summary list rows naming an ownership violation; list items and table body rows only (prose not counted); a row matching an unmatched row of the same phase type and agent in a higher-precedence file (gate then summaries) is duplicate_of and not counted

gate or summary list rows saying the human rewrote an artifact; list items and table body rows only (prose not counted); a row matching an unmatched row of the same phase type and agent in a higher-precedence file (gate then summaries) is duplicate_of and not counted
rows and files the rules cannot place (never guessed)
